## Frequently Asked Questions

Questions?

- What are AI credits?

AI credits power the specific tools your team needs most, from AI Agents to Meeting Notetakers. Instead of a one-size-fits-all fee, credits reflect the complexity of each task, meaning you only pay for the work actually done. A typical 3-person team thrives on ~800–1,200 credits per month. To put that into perspective, 1,000 credits can cover roughly 50 resume screenings, 5 hours of meeting summaries, and hundreds of automated workflow updates. You can track your usage in real-time and purchase more whenever your team needs to scale. Learn more about credits
- Is there a free version of monday.com?

monday.com has a free plan of monday work management which is ideal for freelancers and individual professionals. In addition, we offer a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan for monday work management, monday CRM and monday dev.
- How much does monday.com cost?

monday.com cost depends on the plan you choose and your team size. Plans start from 3 users. If you want to sign up more than 40 users, you can request a quote to get an exact price.
- Can you pay for monday.com monthly?

Yes, you can pay monthly for your account. Choose the monthly option on the pricing page and you will be able to pay on a per-month basis. The monthly plan is not discounted so if you are looking to save, we recommend the yearly plan.
- Which pricing plan is right for me?

We understand that each organization is unique, requiring specific features to support its workflows and projects. Above you can see the features included in the different plans to support your needs. If you need help in choosing the right plan for you, check out this article or reach out to our sales team.
- How does our pricing work?

Our pricing is based on two factors; the feature plan you’d like to use, and the number of users on the platform. Once you’ve decided on the feature plan and users, choose your preferred subscription payment: month-to-month or annual. Payment is made in one upfront installment. If you purchase a plan for one year, you will pay for one year upfront.
- What if I change my mind?

If you've paid for a yearly subscription in the last 30 days, and wish to cancel your account, you are entitled to a partial refund. Meaning, we will automatically refund you the remaining balance from your original purchase. Simply cancel the account from the Admin section, and your account will be automatically refunded. If you have any questions, you can always reach out to our support team
- Do you offer any discounted plans?

Yes, by choosing a yearly plan, you will receive an 18% discount.
- Does monday.com offer plans to nonprofits and NGOs?

monday.com is a proud supporter of organizations that do great things around the world. That’s why we offer discounted pricing for qualified nonprofit organisations. Click here to find out more about our nonprofit plan and pricing.
- How can I manage my billing?

If you are an admin of your account, you can access your purchase history, invoices, payment details, plan type, and more. Learn how to manage your billing details here.
- Can I change my plan?

You can make changes to your plan at any time by changing your plan type and by adding or removing users. However, past the refund period, we offer no refunds for downgrades. To change your plan, simply go into the Admin section and click on the Billing option. From there, click 'change plan' and choose your desired plan.
- How secure is monday.com?

The security of our customer’s data is our top priority. We use advanced security measures to preserve the integrity and privacy of your data, and adhere to strict data protection laws. monday.com is built with internationally recognized security standards and protocols in place, such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27018, and we undergo annual security audits and assessments. 
- What payment methods do you accept?

We accept payments from the following major credit cards, excluding debit cards; Visa, Master Card, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, Carte Bleue, Union Pay. You can also purchase your monday.com subscription with PayPal. Please note this may be subject to change depending on your location. In addition, we accept invoices for Enterprise orders that meet a minimum fee - Feel free to reach out to our support team for more information.
- Do you have mobile apps?

Yes, the platform is available on both IOS and Android devices. You can download them on the Apple or Google Play Stores. Learn more here.

## Here's what's included in Zoho CRM's Standard Edition

Everything in the Free edition, plus additional features to help your business grow.

- Sales Automation
- Customization
- Lead management

## Streamline your growing sales team

### Email integration and mass emails

Keep every customer conversation connected. Integrate your preferred email service with Zoho CRM. Send, receive, and track emails—all in one place. Reach leads, contacts, deals, and records in custom modules with personalized mass emails to make it easier to share updates, nurture relationships, and follow up at scale.

### Workflows and assignment rules

Simplify and automate CRM workflows to update records, send notifications, create tasks, and trigger actions whenever specific conditions are met—all while ensuring every lead and inquiry reaches the relevant owner without manual intervention.

### Cadences

Create automated workflows that nurture leads, send follow-ups, set reminders for callbacks, and keep conversations moving forward. Trigger the right action at the right time based on customer responses.

### Multiple sales pipeline

No two sales processes are the same. Create and track multiple sales processes—with different stages—in Zoho CRM. Customize pipelines to match different ways teams sell while keeping the deals organized and easy to manage. Monitor progress with Kanban views, reports, and dashboards to help your team focus on the deals that are most likely to close.

## Customize, connect, and grow

### Custom modules

Expand your CRM with custom modules, tailored to your business needs using built-in no-code tools, and empower your business to adapt and grow.

### Calendar and marketplace integrations

Bring your meetings, customer data, and business applications together in one place. Schedule meetings directly from Zoho CRM and seamlessly connect with Shopify, WhatsApp, Stripe, and 1,200+ integrations to create a more connected and efficient sales operation.

### Data enrichment

Give your sales team access to the context they need when dealing with customers to build stronger relationships. Using information such as leads' names, companies, or websites, Zoho's AI assistant, Zia, automatically gathers relevant business details from across the web, helping your salespeople gain deeper insights, personalize customer interactions, and identify high-potential opportunities.

## Capture more leads and close more deals

### Sales forecasting

Get ahead of your numbers before the quarter ends. Zoho CRM's sales forecasting gives you an early read on how your pipeline is tracking against your goals, so you can adjust your strategy while there's still time to act.

### Built-in calling

Connect with customers faster by making, receiving, and logging sales calls directly inside Zoho CRM. Keep all call activities linked to the right records, maintain a complete history of customer interactions, and give your sales team the context they need to have more productive conversations.

### Capture data via forms

Turn any prospect into a sales opportunity with built-in forms. Capture leads from anywhere, automatically push data to CRM, and kickstart your sales process the moment a prospect shows interest.

## Frequently Asked Questions

When should I upgrade to the Standard Edition?

If your team is spending time on manual processes, needs more customization, or requires advanced sales management features such as workflows, reporting, and multiple pipelines, Zoho CRM's Standard Edition can help you work more efficiently and grow.

Can I upgrade from the Free edition at any time?

Yes, you can upgrade from the Free Edition to the Standard Edition at any time. Your existing data, records, and configurations remain intact, allowing your team to continue working without disruption while gaining access to additional features and capabilities.

Who is the Standard Edition best suited for?

The Standard Edition is ideal for small and growing businesses that have outgrown basic Zoho CRM requirements and need more automation, customization, reporting, and sales management capabilities to grow further.

How is the Standard Edition better than the Free Edition?

The Free Edition helps businesses get started with the basics of Zoho CRM and the Standard Edition unlocks advanced features and capabilities like workflows, assignment rules, cadences, multiple pipelines, built-in calling, unlimited reports, and integrations with Marketplace, to name just a few. This helps teams save time, improve productivity, and manage sales more effectively.

What other key features come with Standard Edition?

The Standard Edition also includes features like Canvas, which lets you customize the Zoho CRM interface without coding, and Kiosk, which helps streamline data entry and record updates through guided experiences. These features make it easier to tailor Zoho CRM to your business needs and improve user adoption.
